title: Weekly 2026-09-20 — Order fulfilment and exception paths
goal: Follow payment, inventory and delivery exceptions without confusing return routes.

rubric.must: Payment, inventory and shipping groups are all visible.
Yes/No labels can be associated with their own decision branches.
Return, refund and delivery-retry routes do not pass through unrelated node interiors.

provenance.notes: Scenario selected from weekly demand. No customer IDs, contact details or source prompts are included. This is an evaluation input, not a certified correct example.
